results.name: Runners Lunge
instructions: From standing, step one foot far back into a lunge.
Place your hands on the floor beside your front foot.
Lower your hips and extend your back leg.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lower your back knee to rest.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
results.description: Runners Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes.

results.name: Scapula Push Up
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Keep your feet hip-width apart.
Without bending your elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades together, allowing your chest to lower slightly towards the floor.
Push your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly and lifting your chest away from the floor.
Continue to alternate between the retraction and protraction phases for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a steady and controlled movement.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you protract and inhaling as you retract your shoulder blades.
Maintain a straight body line, avoiding any sagging or arching of the back.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
results.description: Scapula Push Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Scorpion Twist Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched out to the sides.
Bend one knee.
Lift and rotate that leg across your body toward the opposite hand.
Return and switch sides.
tips: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Move slowly.
results.description: Scorpion Twist Pose is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Glutes.

results.name: Seated Cross Leg Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right leg over your left thigh and lightly bend your left knee placing your left foot flat on the floor.
Keeping your back straight, lower your chest towards your crossed leg, reaching your hands straight to the floor to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your right glute. Slowly release and return to the starting position. Repeat on the left side.
tips: Maintain a straight back as you lower your chest to enhance the effectiveness of the stretch.
Move slowly and with control to prevent any sudden movements that could cause strain.
Ensure your bent knees remains stable and aligned with your body to avoid placing excess strain on the knee joints.
results.description: Seated Cross Leg Glute Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hips, Lower Back.

results.name: Seated Side Stretch
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Extend your right arm overhead, keeping your left hand holding on the bench for support.
Lean your torso to the left, reaching your right arm over your head and to the left side, feeling the stretch along the right side of your body.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then slowly return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side by extending your left arm overhead and leaning to the right.
tips: Move into the stretch gradually, ensuring that your movements are controlled to avoid muscle strain.
Ensure your supporting hand is firmly placed on the bench to maintain stability.
Perform the stretch on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
results.description: Seated Side Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Side Lying Parsva Savasana Variation
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees slightly bent.
Rest your head on your arm or a cushion.
Let your whole body relax.
Breathe slowly and stay for the set time.
tips: Place a cushion between your knees.
Focus on your breathing.
results.description: Side Lying Parsva Savasana Variation is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category.

results.name: Side Plank With Hip Lift
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Raise your left arm straight toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Once in the top position, perform two small controlled bounces with your hips, lifting them slightly higher each time.
Lower your hips back to the floor without touching it and repeat the steps for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side and perform the exercise on your left side.
tips: Move your hips slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your elbow is directly under your shoulder to support your upper body.
results.description: Side Plank With Hip Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders.

results.name: Superman Holds
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended straight out in front of you and your legs extended straight behind you.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor as high as you comfortably can, engaging your lower back and glutes.
Hold the lifted position for 5-10 seconds, feeling the contraction in your lower back and glutes.
Slowly lower your arms, chest, and legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your lower back and glute muscles to lift your body off the floor.
Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid straining it.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your body.
results.description: Superman Holds is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Wild Thing Pose
instructions: From a side plank, step your top foot back behind you with the knee bent.
Lift your hips.
Reach your top arm overhead and open your chest toward the ceiling.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep pressing the floor away with your supporting hand.
Move slowly into the backbend.
results.description: Wild Thing Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Glutes, Core.

results.name: Yoga Flow Sequences Sun Salutations
instructions: Stand tall, raise your arms overhead, then fold forward.
Step back into a plank and lower to the floor.
Lift into a cobra or upward dog, then push back into downward dog.
Step forward, rise up with your arms overhead and repeat the flow.
tips: Link each movement with one breath.
Move at a pace that keeps your breathing steady.
results.description: Yoga Flow Sequences Sun Salutations is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings, Core.
